title: [Peek] Incorrect window/content scaling when re-triggering Peek on a different display
summary: The issue contains a deterministic multi-monitor reproduction, explicit expected and actual behavior, screenshots, and monitor scaling values. The report is sufficiently scoped for a full design investigation without asserting a root cause during fast triage.

status.label: Design in progress
status.detail: A detailed implementation-grade design is being prepared. No maintainer action is exposed until the design is complete and validated.

judgment.rationale: The issue contains a deterministic multi-monitor reproduction, explicit expected and actual behavior, screenshots, and monitor scaling values. The report is sufficiently scoped for a full design investigation without asserting a root cause during fast triage.
evidence: Labels include Issue-Bug, Needs-Triage, and Product-Peek.
The body provides five ordered reproduction steps across displays with 125% and 175% scaling.
The expected behavior is reopening Peek at the correct size on the first display; the actual behavior is an incorrect window or content size.
Multiple screenshots document the incorrect and correct states.
The automated triage comment marks reproduction as sufficient and describes the issue as a scaling regression after moving Peek between displays.
judgment.recommended_action: Queue a bounded full design investigation for Peek display-DPI and window-content sizing transitions.
